latest_release.body:
### Patch Changes

- [#10593](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/pull/10593) [`528bfe9`](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/commit/528bfe964f1306f7070fd4efe034873b5f1cfe45) - `MessageRepository.import` now leaves the repository unchanged when it throws, for example when a message's parent or the head is missing. Thread `import` and `reset`, and loading history in the local runtime, check the data before clearing the current messages, so a history that cannot be placed no longer empties the thread. ([@Yonom](https://github.com/Yonom))

- [#10597](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/pull/10597) [`f1a812d`](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/commit/f1a812d2d1a6c824ea397d798a9b158f750b7804) - never run a frontend tool's `execute` for a tool call the backend owns. Tool-call parts gain `providerExecuted`: the tool invocation tracker, `ToolExecutionStream` and `unstable_runPendingTools` skip a call that carries it, even when the run ends before the backend's result arrives. UI message streams set it for provider-executed calls, the data stream format carries it from `addToolCallPart({ providerExecuted: true })` to the client, and `@assistant-ui/ai-sdk` sets it from the AI SDK part's `providerExecuted`. A dynamic tool call is marked only when its part carries `providerExecuted: true`, so otherwise it stays client-runnable as it is in the AI SDK. `@assistant-ui/react-langchain` holds a call while the graph is paused on an interrupt, and `@assistant-ui/eve` never hands a call to a frontend tool. ([@Yonom](https://github.com/Yonom))

- [#10641](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/pull/10641) [`8f30cfc`](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/commit/8f30cfc76b6e1483cc390a293eafc4d8fffb2bcd) - Keep Cloud message ID mappings available when a thread history moves from its live item to the listed item, so edits to loaded messages reach Cloud. ([@rupic-app](https://github.com/apps/rupic-app))

- [#10601](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/pull/10601) [`11afc02`](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/commit/11afc0276e87cc0834342d6fdeeaaf0595fccdbe) - fix(cloud): loading a thread follows `has_more` from the message list, so a page that ends before its limit no longer ends the thread early ([@Yonom](https://github.com/Yonom))

- [#10666](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/pull/10666) [`d9a7f68`](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/commit/d9a7f68b5a38fcc3f68b5acf127f71dd5b8a6837) - keep how a dictation session ended. Composer state gains `lastDictationEnd` (`{ reason, error?: AssistantError }`), set when a session ends and cleared before the next adapter listen attempt, so a UI can explain a failed dictation after `dictation` returns to `undefined`. The ended `DictationAdapter.Status` gains `error?: unknown`, which the composer normalizes to `AssistantError`, and `WebSpeechDictationAdapter` fills it with the browser's `{ code, message }` (for example `not-allowed` for a blocked microphone). `DictationEnd` is exported. ([@vidiyala99](https://github.com/vidiyala99))

- [#10594](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/pull/10594) [`8c67589`](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/commit/8c67589ca1b3ffac888c19e9a2759ee7c052ce4b) - `fromThreadMessageLike` (used for `convertMessage` and `initialMessages`) now checks file, image and source parts with the same rules as the local storage and cloud history readers, so a malformed part is handled the same way on every runtime. A part is dropped when a field it needs to render has the wrong type: a file's `data` or `mimeType`, an image's `image`, a url source's `id` or `url`, a document source's `id`, `title` or `mediaType`. An optional field that is `null` or of the wrong type is removed and the part is kept: a file's `filename`, a file's `sourceType` when it is not `"url"` or `"id"`, an image's `filename`, a url source's `title`, a document source's `filename`. Product · Documentation · Examples · Discord · Contact Sales

## The UX of ChatGPT in your React app 💬🚀 **assistant-ui** is an open-source TypeScript/React library to build production-grade AI chat experiences fast. ## Installation The fastest path is the CLI, which scaffolds a Next.js app or adds the styled components to an existing project: ```bash npx assistant-ui@latest create # new project npx assistant-ui@latest init # add to existing project ``` Or install the packages directly: ```bash npm install @assistant-ui/react @assistant-ui/ai-sdk ai ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { AssistantRuntimeProvider } from "@assistant-ui/react"; import { useChatRuntime } from "@assistant-ui/ai-sdk"; import { Thread } from "@/components/assistant-ui/elements/thread.aui"; export function Chat() { const runtime = useChatRuntime(); return ( ); } ``` `useChatRuntime` connects to the Vercel AI SDK out of the box. Swap it for `useLangGraphRuntime`, `useDataStreamRuntime`, or any custom runtime to integrate with your own backend. ## What you get - **Composable primitives**: build any chat UX from `Thread`, `Message`, `Composer`, `ThreadList`, `ActionBar`, and friends. Style every pixel yourself, or start from a polished shadcn/ui theme that the CLI copies into your project. - **Production UX out of the box**: streaming, auto-scroll, retries, attachments, markdown, code highlighting, voice dictation, keyboard shortcuts, and accessibility. - **Generative UI**: render tool calls and JSON as React components, collect inline human approvals, and expose safe frontend actions to the model. - **Strong TypeScript**: typed runtime APIs, tool schemas, message parts, and adapters end to end. ## Backends | Integration | Package | | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | | Vercel AI SDK | `@assistant-ui/ai-sdk` | | LangGraph / LangChain | `@assistant-ui/react-langgraph`, `@assistant-ui/react-langchain` | | AG-UI / A2A protocols | `@assistant-ui/react-ag-ui`, `@assistant-ui/react-a2a` | | Google ADK / OpenCode | `@assistant-ui/react-google-adk`, `@assistant-ui/react-opencode` | | Custom data-stream backend | `@assistant-ui/react-data-stream` | | Managed thread history, telemetry, and file storage | `assistant-cloud` | Broad model support out of the box (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Perplexity, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Fireworks, Ollama) plus community providers via the AI SDK, and easy extension to any custom HTTP backend. ## Customization Instead of a single monolithic chat component, you compose primitives and bring your own styles. The CLI ships a great starter in your choice of Base UI (the default) or Radix UI flavor; you control everything else. ## Used in production by
